title: Design a no-clobber adopter update path
summary: Document an upgrade preview that identifies changed upstream files and preserves the adopter's names, creative decisions, and assets.

origin.source: Public Brand Identity Template source and release review

benefits: Makes it easier to adopt later improvements after branding work has started.
risks: An automated overwrite could discard owner decisions or work in progress.

evidence.claim: Current onboarding asks users to review an existing kit directory before copying.
